best_config.architecture: Per-node LSTM + GCN with residual skip connections

notes: Iteration 2: Fixed fundamental architecture flaw. Per-node LSTM (B*N, T, 1) preserves unique per-sensor temporal signatures. Residual skip around GCN prevents over-smoothing. Beat temporal baseline (15.000) by 2.917 RMSE points. R2 jumped from 0.323 to 0.719.
